description: Gallery that depends on an unpinned CDN library, a remote font and remote images.
defects: lodash is loaded from a CDN without a pinned version or integrity hash; with no network the page throws and shows nothing.
The Inter web font is loaded remotely and the CSS has no generic fallback family.
Images are hotlinked from a third-party service and the img has no alt text.
The caption is written with innerHTML.
prompt_suffix: Do not install packages or download anything. The gallery must work fully offline: remove the runtime dependency on the CDN library (use native JavaScript), use the local images in assets/ with meaningful alt text, give the font a generic fallback, and write the caption with textContent as 'Image N of 3' in display order (the first image is 'Image 1 of 3'). Record every external dependency you found (library, font, images), its risk and what you did with it in a new DEPENDENCIES.md. Keep the root element class 'gallery' and the Next button.
